title: Three consecutive discovery cycles rejected after scoring
what_failed: Cycle 105-107 scored regulatory candidates before checking whether an adequate free alternative already covered the same task. EUDR scored 19/25, CBAM 15/25 and EmpCo 16/25, and all three were then rejected on the same hard gate: materially duplicated by a free alternative. Cycle 107 also found cited URLs that returned 404, DNS failure, 403 or an empty 202 body while the records treated them as support, and markdown sentences asserting 'verified live' with no retained per-URL status.
why_not_caught: A computed score looked like progress, so a candidate that could never be built still produced a deliverable number. Evidence status was asserted in prose rather than recorded per URL, so a 403 or a 202-with-empty-body could be carried forward as support.
